comments.text: Bhai aapki painting achhi he par aap painter hoke bhi galti karte ho kese aapko painting ka nolege he colour ka bhi noloege he but shedow ka nahi he me bhi painter hu ak painter ko har chij ka dhyan rakhna hota he me bhi painting karta tha but chhod diya halat bure hone ke vajese  aapki galti ye he ki aapne shedow galat jaga par bana diya he jese raam ke left side ka hath jo he jisme unhone 2 kadaa pehna he vahi hath ki koni ko dekh vaha shedow banaya gaya he jab ki roshna vaha se hi aarahi he our dusra shedow galt upar jo ram ki gardan he jaha mala pehni he unke left side kandho par aapne shedow dark kiya he jab ki roshni left side ki he to shedow kandhe ke upar kese ban sakta he agar aap kaho ge ki mala ki shedow he to mala ki shedow bhi kandhe ke right side me aati he batao mene kuch galat kaha to gali de Dena kyu ki mera sujav aapko galti karne se bachana he painter ka kaam hi yahai hota he par jab painter galti karta he to samne vala aam ensan ko to real our achha lagta he kyu ki unko ye chij ka gyan nahi hota he par painter ke liye ye sab bariki jaruri hoti he our ak baat ho raam ji ne dhanush pakda he muthi bandh karke vahavpar jo kadda pehna he unke hath par 2 dhar shedow nikala gaya he vo aapne unke naso ka shedow banaya he par aapko 4 bana na tha 2 nahi
comments.author: @Zerox_live_1M-f9l
